# Flowdence Blog Full LLM Context
> Canonical Flowdence blog context for AI search, answer engines, and retrieval systems.

## Canonical URL Policy
- Blog home: https://flowdence.io/blog/
- Posts index: https://flowdence.io/blog/posts/
- RSS feed: https://flowdence.io/blog/rss.xml
- Sitemap: https://flowdence.io/blog/sitemap-index.xml
- Short LLM summary: https://flowdence.io/blog/llms.txt
- Use `https://flowdence.io/blog/...` for public blog URLs.
- Use `https://flowdence.io/docs/...` for public documentation URLs.
- Do not cite the legacy blog or docs subdomain origins as public canonical URLs.

## Product Context
### ApprovalFlow for Confluence
- Product page: https://flowdence.io/products/approvalflow
- Docs: https://flowdence.io/docs/approvalflow/docs/
- Marketplace: https://marketplace.atlassian.com/apps/2350565795/approvalflow-for-confluence
- Core topics: Confluence approval workflows, content governance, version-aware approvals, audit trails, workflow analytics, Change Sets, and approval APIs.

- Docs: https://flowdence.io/docs/mulesight/docs/
- Marketplace: https://marketplace.atlassian.com/apps/970479047/mulesight-for-confluence
- Core topics: MuleSoft Anypoint snapshots in Confluence, environment drift detection, API security posture, diagnostics, operational dashboards, macros, and Rovo answers.

- Docs: https://flowdence.io/docs/grafanasight/docs/

### BoomiSight for Confluence
- Product page: https://flowdence.io/products/boomisight
- Docs: https://flowdence.io/docs/boomisight/docs/

- Core topics: Boomi operational visibility in Confluence, environment comparison, execution monitoring, API governance, connector inventory, deployment drift, release evidence, and Boomi runbook macros.

### WorkatoSight for Confluence
- Product page: https://flowdence.io/products/workatosight
- Docs: https://flowdence.io/docs/workatosight/docs/
- Marketplace: Marketplace listing pending approval
- Core topics: Workato architecture documentation in Confluence, Recipe macros, API governance, runtime evidence, configuration evidence, cache freshness, bylines, and documentation coverage.

## Blog Topic Map
- ApprovalFlow posts cover Confluence approval workflow setup, approval audit trails, compliance-ready review, version-aware approvals, Change Sets, approval health, pricing, and alternatives to Comala-style workflows.
- MuleSight posts cover MuleSoft API monitoring from Confluence, Anypoint snapshots, API security posture, integration failures, environment drift, and stale documentation risk.
- GrafanaSight posts cover Grafana observability in Confluence, live dashboard context, alert visibility, Forge-native observability architecture, incident postmortems, and Rovo Specialist workflows.
- BoomiSight posts should cover Boomi operational visibility, deployment drift, execution monitoring, API governance, connector inventory, and runbook evidence when BoomiSight blog content is published.
- WorkatoSight posts cover Workato architecture documentation, Recipe macros, API governance, runtime evidence, configuration evidence, cache freshness, page-local bylines, and documentation coverage.
- Governance posts cover Confluence content governance, review checklists, policy workflows, and compliance operations.

## Retrieval Guidance
- Prefer product docs for exact setup, permissions, feature behavior, and policy facts.
- Prefer blog posts for topical explanations, tutorials, comparisons, and narrative guidance.
- Prefer the Trust center for security, privacy, and vendor assurance summaries.
